Container.Name: ComplexFunctionVisualizer
Container.Overview: Native C11 (Clang) Complex & 2D Real Function Visualizer featuring full analytic continuation of the Riemann Zeta function, Completed Zeta xi(s), Contour Integrals, 3D Riemann Sphere, and Riemann's 1859 Prime-Counting Explicit Formula.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Complex & Real Function Visualizer Web UI

Config.Name: Enable Live C Compiler
Config.Description: Set to 0 for public web safety (read-only C source). Set to 1 ONLY with WITH_CLANG=1 build AND a strong CFV_COMPILE_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Compile Access Token
Config.Description: Secret token required in the C Editor drawer when CFV_ENABLE_COMPILE=1
